data.content_ref: inline:The target does not answer the second half of the problem: what evidence within a single evaluation distinguishes genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance that happens to track the right answer. It gives a variance-reduction account for why the panel is reliable and two counterconditions, but no diagnostic evidence. A panel that mechanically ticks boxes and happens to be correct would exhibit the same low variance the target cites as the mechanism; variance reduction alone cannot separate genuine gain from compliant tracking.
